original.target_description: Study 1: camp-size main effect on preference ratings, 2 × 2 within-subjects ANOVA; small versus large Rwanda camp, averaging domestic comparison programs.

n.sample_role: participants in target analysis; analytic n unestablished
n.exclusions: 54 volunteers are reported, but target F(1,52) is inconsistent with that total; no analytic n explicitly established. No participant exclusion explanation found.

replication.target_description: Study 1b: post-exclusion simple main effect of camp size when compared with employment program, collapsing evaluation round. Transportation comparison is a separate test.

n.quote: The sample after exclusion consisted of 723 participants
n.exclusions: 750 British Prolific participants recruited; exclusions detailed in supplement.

es.location: author manuscript p. 25 (PDF p. 28), Replication results
es.quote: were compared with the employment program, t(1189) = 13.67, p < .001, d = 0.40

p.location: author manuscript p. 25 (PDF p. 28), Replication results
p.quote: were compared with the employment program, t(1189) = 13.67, p < .001, d = 0.40

reported_success.quote:
While the original results were not successfully replicated, Study 1a results were

successfully replicated.

notes: Author preprint pagination differs from supplied p. 7. Broad locator does not distinguish two comparison-program simple effects. Selected employment comparison explicitly; transportation comparison is t(1189)=10.32, p<.001, d=0.30. The reported sample is 723 participants, not the model contrast df. Original prints F, no d for target test; no conversion.
